title: The Starry Night
official_description: A night landscape with a swirling sky over a quiet village, painted in 1889.
historical_context: Made while the artist was staying at a care facility in southern France in 1889.
visual_description: A deep blue sky full of swirling motion, large glowing stars, a bright moon, a dark cypress tree in front, and a small village with a church spire below.

sources.title: ATLAS demo note: The Starry Night
sources.license_note: Original placeholder educational text written for ATLAS. Not museum copy.

chunks.text: The Starry Night is a 1889 oil painting by Vincent van Gogh showing a swirling night sky above a calm village.
The sky swirls in waves of blue with bright yellow stars and a glowing moon, while a tall dark cypress rises in front of a sleeping village.
Look up! The sky is swirling like waves, with big shiny stars and a glowing moon over a tiny sleeping town.
La Nuit etoilee est une peinture a l'huile de 1889 par Vincent van Gogh montrant un ciel nocturne tourbillonnant au-dessus d'un village paisible.
Le ciel tourbillonne en vagues bleues avec des etoiles jaunes et une lune brillante, tandis qu'un grand cypres sombre se dresse devant un village endormi.
